name: Cultist: Terror boosts the spell damage bonus of its three named spells natively (#1551)
contract: 300304 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue=24 (SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER) on both effects; EffectBasePoints/DieSides give effect0 +20% (classmask dword1 bit5) and effect1 +10% (classmask dword1 bit4 + dword2 bit19). Verified against Spell.dbc: 800413 'Wrath of the Black Empire' (SpellFamilyFlags dword1=288=256+32, bit5 set) gets +20%; 800416 'Horrorbolt' (dword1=16, bit4) and 808043 'Eldritch Shock' (dword2=524288, bit19) get +10%. SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER is applied at the same Unit.cpp call sites (e.g. Unit.cpp:9359) that compute real spell-damage AP/SP coefficients, via Player::ApplySpellMod -- the exact call the spell_modifier metric exercises. No script needed; 300304 is not in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 routing table.
